releaseNotes.title: X-Menu V2.0.2
releaseNotes.body: Setup Market now uses real vehicle names, defaults to Main, and includes expanded diagnostics. Car Generator is now available on Tester. Backend and update-compatibility work has also reduced unnecessary game-version-specific dependencies.

launcher.message: Launcher v0.7.7 prepares the new branch structure and revalidates channel access before each action.
